project_type: Go daemon (Android arm64) + Magisk module + WebUI
build_system: Go modules, shell scripts, GitHub Actions
test_framework: No test framework currently in use; validation is via go build + go vet + sh -n
build_command: GOROOT=/root/.local/share/mise/installs/go/1.23.8 PATH=/root/.local/share/mise/installs/go/1.23.8/bin:$PATH GOOS=android GOARCH=arm64 CGO_ENABLED=0 go build -trimpath -buildvcs=false -ldflags='-s -w -X main.version=3.0.0' -o /tmp/sshcustomd ./cmd/sshcustomd/
verification_instructions: 1. Build daemon with GOOS=android GOARCH=arm64 CGO_ENABLED=0. 2. Run go vet ./... 3. Verify binary is arm64 with file command. 4. Run sh -n on all module/scripts/*
setup_instructions: Use Go 1.23.8 at /root/.local/share/mise/installs/go/1.23.8/bin/go. Set GOROOT appropriately. The go.mod is in daemon/ directory.
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET network. Go 1.23.8 available via mise. Must cross-compile for GOOS=android GOARCH=arm64 CGO_ENABLED=0. No Android device available for runtime testing. Use go vet and build success as validation.
contribution_requirements: Go module path: github.com/GoodyOG/SSHCustom_Magisk. Ports: socks 1081, redir 9799, tproxy 9899, HTTP API 9190. iptables chains: SSHC_ prefix. Module data path: /data/adb/sshcustom/
key_patterns: Daemon uses atomic.Pointer[issh.Client] for current SSH client. Proxy servers accept func() *issh.Client for getting current client. tunnelLoop manages transparent reconnect - keeps iptables and listeners UP across SSH drops. State struct with mu sync.RWMutex for concurrent access. buildHTTPMux creates HTTP API handlers. Config uses AtomicConfig with Load+swap pattern.
directory_structure: daemon/ - Go source (cmd/sshcustomd/main.go entry, internal/ packages). module/ - Magisk module (scripts/, bin/, META-INF/, vpnchain/, settings.ini, module.prop, service.sh). app/ - Kotlin Android app (TO BE DELETED). .github/workflows/ - CI. docs/ - documentation.
